# Library

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(dLagM)
library(dynlm)
library(forecast)
library(Metrics)
```

# Data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("D:\\Mine\\Kuliah Journey\\Semester 5\\MPDW\\mpdw_066\\Pertemuan 3\\NewDelhi_Air_quality.csv")
head(df)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    t = row_number(),
    Yt = AQI,
    Yt_1 = lag(AQI, 1),
    Xt = CO
  ) %>%
  select(t, Yt, Yt_1, Xt)

head(data, 10)
```

# Eksplorasi Data

```{r}

```

```{r}
dim(data)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```

# Split

```{r}
n <- nrow(data)

n_train <- floor(0.8 * n)

# bagi data
train <- data[1:n_train, ]
test  <- data[(n_train+1):n, ]

# ubah ke time series
train.ts <- ts(train)
test.ts  <- ts(test)
data.ts <- ts(data)
```
